label: baseline

env.image: Kaggle GPU image 2026-11-06, torch from the image (2.11.0+cu130 in the same-day kernel llt-insdata-teacher)
env.pinned: transformers 5.22.1, tokenizers 0.23.3, huggingface_hub 2.4.0, datasets 5.1.0, trl 1.17.1, accelerate 1.15.0, sentence-transformers 6.2.0, lm-eval 0.4.13, langdetect 1.0.9

config.regex: email, phone, IPv4, card numbers that pass the Luhn check, written without backslashes
config.ner: dslim/bert-base-NER, PER entities with score 0.9 or more, English WildChat prompts, first 1,500 characters
config.handling: drop every row with a regex hit from the curated set; report NER hits, do not drop on a name alone
config.kernel: llt-insdata-notebook v1 (cells 1 to 7 completed; cell 10 stopped on CUDA out of memory, fixed and re-run in llt-insdata-exp)

wallClockNote: measured while other jobs shared the machine; not a timing figure for the page
